summary: Episode 27: A paper merchant reached the souk with bales of cheap paper from far away, and Tariq saw a chance — with paper this affordable he could copy Salim's books for everyone in the reading circle. He carried an armful home, and grandfather and grandson spent the evening preparing fresh pages together. Salim taught him that sharing knowledge is a form of worship, and the reading circle swelled as Tariq handed out copied pages. Noor still doesn't know who leaves the gifts at her door.
open_threads: Noor still doesn't know who leaves the anonymous gifts at her door (Tariq knows it is Salim)
Tariq is learning patience and mastering his temper
The reading circle is growing quickly now that Tariq can copy books onto cheap paper
The traveler is gone, carrying the district's kindness into the world
